about: The machines and animals of a Philippine land preparation (2026-10-15), as the Land Prep Planner offers them. rates: machine days per hectare for each kind of work (plow, harrow, harrowlevel, level, roughlevel, light, furrow), typical field rates, a guide only. for: all, rice_wet (rice except dry seeding), or a list of planting methods. plants: a planting machine, booked for the planting day. photo: a freely licensed photo with its author, licence and file page.

hand_tractor.line: Pulls a plow, a harrow or a leveling board
